subject: Escrow release conditions, annual commitment sweep & VAT evidence
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Bates <sarah.bates@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Escrow release conditions, annual commitment sweep & VAT evidence

Hi Sarah —

Following our last call, we want to align on the release criteria for the annual committed-spend sweep so Finance can automate the drawdown without manual holds. Attached is a proposed release-criteria checklist and our snapshot of the VAT jurisdictions we currently have on file. Key asks: 

1) Confirm the list of countries where Acme requires VAT evidence prior to sweep (we've called out the UK, Germany, France, and Netherlands in the attachment).
2) For any country that needs a specific invoice or certificate (e.g., UK reverse-charge proof), please flag the exact artifact name and acceptable formats (PDF/CSV).
3) Confirm whether Treasury requires a multi-sig approval or if a single AP approval is sufficient for releases under the committed amount.

If you can provide the VAT artifacts or a sample invoice by end of day Wednesday (48 hours), our ops team will stage the sweep for the following Thursday (Nov 18) and share a final ledger extract beforehand. Once we have confirmation we'll also send a DocuSign amendment to attach the sweep schedule to the existing commitment.

Attachments: release-criteria-checklist.xlsx; acme_vat_snapshot_Q4-2026.pdf

Thanks — looking to keep the window tight so we don't delay provisioning.

Jordan Blake
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0191

From: Sarah Bates <sarah.bates@acmecloud.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@acmecloud.com>, Acme Cloud Finance <ap@acmecloud.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:05:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Escrow release conditions, annual commitment sweep & VAT evidence

Jordan —

Thanks for the checklist, much appreciated. A few clarifications from our side: 

- For the UK we need either an exported invoice marked with the reverse-charge note + our VAT registration (PDF), or our VAT certificate showing registered business activity. Both are accepted; PDF preferred.
- Germany and France: we require a copy of the tax residence certificate (if the buyer is claiming exemption) or the full paid invoice.
- Netherlands: if the amount is above €50k we need Treasury to sign off on the sweep. Below that, AP approval is enough.

We don't currently have a multi-sig workflow for these sweeps. Treasury will confirm by EOD whether they want multi-sig for >€50k. Tom (cc'd) will route the VAT certificate bundle to you; should be a single ZIP with named PDFs.

We'll upload the VAT bundle to the Drive link you shared and also attach here for convenience. Expect: acme_vat_certificates.zip (contains UK_vat_cert.pdf, DE_residence.pdf, FR_invoice_202610.pdf).

Also: what GL code will Redwood post to so we can map payments in our ledger?

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Bates
Director, Finance Operations — Acme Cloud
sarah.bates@acmecloud.com

Attachments: acme_vat_certificates.zip

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Bates <sarah.bates@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 12:30:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Escrow release conditions, annual commitment sweep & VAT evidence

Sarah —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the ZIP. A couple internal notes so expectations are clear: 

- Once we have the ZIP and confirm the artifacts match the checklist, Finance (Marissa) will trigger the ledger-ready sweep file. That file will include the invoice references and the GL posting code.
- GL mapping: Redwood will post to GL 4-2300 (Deferred revenue sweep). If Acme needs a different mapping we can alter the batch metadata; please provide the mapping by Friday so we don't block the sweep.
- Approvals: if Treasury requires multi-sig for >€50k, please confirm by COB Thursday so we can implement the conditional hold in the workflow. If not, AP approval will be auto-applied.

Rishi — can you draft the DocuSign amendment (short addendum attaching the sweep cadence and release checklist) and share for legal review? Target: draft to Sarah by EOD tomorrow.

Action items recap:
- Sarah/Acme: upload ZIP + confirm any special country rules (by EOD Wed).
- Acme Treasury (Tom): confirm multi-sig threshold (by COB Thu).
- Rishi: DocuSign draft (by EOD Thu).
- Marissa: prepare ledger extract template and GL mapping sample (by Fri morning).

Thanks — we'll stand by to validate the artifacts when uploaded.

Kimberly Park
VP, Finance Ops, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Bates <sarah.bates@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Legal <legal@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Escrow release conditions, annual commitment sweep & VAT evidence

Sarah / team —

Thanks for the artifacts upload and the confirmation from Tom that Treasury does not require multi-sig for this sweep (Tom confirmed in a separate note at 14:10). We reviewed the ZIP and everything aligns with our checklist. Next steps: 

- We've uploaded the DocuSign amendment (link below) that attaches the release criteria and authorizes Redwood to execute the scheduled sweep on Nov 18, 2026 pending final AP sign-off. Please review and complete your signature block by Nov 16 EOD.
- Marissa will send the ledger extract on Nov 17 so you have visibility before the movement on Nov 18.
- GL posting will be to 4-2300 unless you send an alternate mapping by Nov 15.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/commitment/ACME-20261111 
Attachments: docsign_commitment_amendment_20261111.pdf

If anything changes to Treasury's threshold, flag immediately — we will implement a conditional hold. Appreciate the quick coordination on VAT evidence; that materially shortens turnaround.

Jordan Blake
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0191
